patrol-app.title: Patrol Panel
patrol-app.toggleSteppingDisabled: Auto Patrol is disabled in Combat and while stepping single Tokens

patrolMaxSuspicious.name: Max Suspicious Steps
patrolMaxSuspicious.hint: Number of steps a token looks around before trying to chase a PC

patrolMaxAlerted.name: Max Alerted Steps
patrolMaxAlerted.hint: Number of steps a token must have line of sight on a chased PC before actually spotting it

patrolSound.name: Spotted Sound
patrolSound.hint: Sound to play when a PC is spotted by an enemy

patrolAlert.name: Alerted Sound
patrolAlert.hint: Sound to play when an enemy is alerted by a PC

openApplication.name: Patrol Panel
openApplication.hint: Open the Patrol Panel. You can also Alt+LClick on the Patrol button in Token Scene Controls or use the 'ui.patrolApp.render({ force: true })' macro command.
openApplication.label: Open Patrol Panel

minStepDelay.name: Minimum Step Delay
minStepDelay.hint: Minimum delay between steps in milliseconds. If shorter than Animation Duration, Animation Duration will be used instead. Actual time between movements will be dependant on Foundry's Token updates and Token movement on the map. Lower values can be resource intensive.

animationDuration.name: Animation Duration
animationDuration.hint: Duration of Token movement animations in milliseconds.

hidePatrolButtonInSidebar.name: Hide Patrol Panel button in Sidebar
hidePatrolButtonInSidebar.hint: Hide the Patrol Panel button in the Actor Directory sidebar. You can still use the 'ui.patrolApp.render({ force: true })' macro command or Alt+LClick on the Patrol button in Token Scene Controls.

migrateOnStartupDialog.name: Open migration dialog on startup
migrateOnStartupDialog.hint: If enabled, the module will open a dialog to migrate the data from the V13 data structure to the V14 one on startup.

enableSpotting.name: Spot Player Characters
enableSpotting.hint: Having multiple spotting tokens can be resource intensive. Handle with care.

choices.useRegionSettings: Use Region Settings (also uses Region's 'Leave Door Open')

leaveDoorOpen.name: Leave Door Open
leaveDoorOpen.hint: Chance that the Token will leave a door open after passing through it

type.label: Type
type.hint: Choose if tokens will patrol the area or guard its edges

weight.label: Weight
weight.hint: How much weight this area has in the patrol algorithm. Higher weights will be preferred over lower ones.

min.label: Darkness Min
min.hint: Minimum darkness level for this area to be considered for patrol.

max.label: Darkness Max
max.hint: Maximum darkness level for this area to be considered for patrol.

darkness.validationError: Darkness min must be lower than darkness max.
